description.text: Professional profile Founded in 2002, the biotechnology major of Wenzhou University is a key construction major of Wenzhou University in the "Twelfth Five-Year Plan", which conforms to the national strategy of "Healthy China", is based on the frontier of life sciences, closely focuses on the development of talent needs in the biological health industry, aims to cultivate international vision, master the core basic theoretical knowledge of biotechnology and high-level professional operation skills, and can be able to study in life science research, biotechnology transformation, biosafety testing, High-level application-oriented talents in biotechnology education and food safety management.Core courses Biochemistry, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Organic Chemistry, Genetics, Chemical Engineering, Genetic Engineering, Bioinformatics, Fermentation Engineering, Biological Separation Engineering, Food Safety Testing, Food Safety and Quality Control, etc.

duration.text: The Biotechnology at Wenzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Graduation certificate of high school.*Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.2.An official transcript from the school you have graduated.* Official transcript should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3.Certificate of English proficiency test.*IELTS or TOEFL will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker(a minimum score should be obtained as follows: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL IBT 70, or TOEFL paper based 550).4.A photocopy of your passport.5.Bank statement (normally the balance is enough for your first year tuition fee and accommodation fee).6.No Criminal Report.7.Health report (within the period of validity).

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport;2.High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate;3.Be in good health condition and above the age of 18.
